prior_summary: A goal-relative predictive object-factorization prior: a shared encoder represents each block's two-frame relationship to the TCP and its own pad, and supervised causal relational forecasts condition one absolute-joint epsilon diffusion U-Net alongside the complete normalized observations.
applicable_conditions: The supplied two-block sorting task with observed Panda joints, finger positions, TCP pose, both block poses and their paired world-frame goals. The same model covers reset, approach, grasp, lift, transport, placement, release, inter-object travel and demonstrated final retreat. Color identity and absolute robot state are retained; no action-space equivariance is assumed.
termination_guidance: Use only the unchanged evaluator's simultaneous red_at_goal AND blue_at_goal geometric success or its physical step limit. Forecasts and geometric margin features are learned conditioning, not termination logic. Do not add a release, clearance, velocity or sustained-hold requirement.
limitations: The twelve demonstrations have narrow start variation, near-upright cubes and red-before-blue behavior. No recovery coverage or unseen-layout performance is established. Two observations cannot identify arbitrary dwell duration. State-only forecasts may average ambiguous futures and do not certify the physical consequences of sampled actions. Shared relational features do not make absolute Panda joint targets equivariant or supply inverse kinematics.

config.training_recipe: Unchanged supplied full-task training contract; seed 0, 60000 updates, final EMA only.
